full_judgment: 4. Predecessor of opposite party Nos. I and 2 of this Civil Revision Petition as plaintiff laid a suit being Title Suit No. 205 of 1985 in the Court of Munsif, Sadar, Sylhet for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession with respect to property described in schedule to the plaint. The schedule property will be referred to hereinafter as suit property. The Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh as defendant No. 1 contested the said suit on presentation of a written statement. The said suit was dismissed by the judgment and decree dated 23.9.1986. Plaintiff sought setting aside the above judgment and decree through a medium of appeal being title Appeal No. 246 of 1986 before the learned District Judge, Sylhet. Second Court of learned Subordinate Judge, Sylhet heard the appeal and by judgment and decree dated 16.4.1987 allowed the appeal and reversed the decisions rendered by trial Judge and decreed the suit. Decree-holder plaintiff put the decree into execution in Title Execution Case No. 5 of 1987.
